Task 2.0: PSCs durability benchmarking Task Summary: To evaluate process compatibility and optoelectronic performance of monolithically integrated IZO/TCC/PSC devices, photovoltaic (PV) metrics were benchmarked and assessed before and after encapsulation. Accelerated aging tests were conducted on encapsulated PSCs to quantify improvements in operational lifetimes compared to their unencapsulated counterparts. Subtask 2.1 – Electrical testing of encapsulated PSC devices: Unprotected and encapsulated cells were tested continuously near their maximum power point (“quasi- MPP” technique) in a laboratory at 50 °C, in air (40-60% R.H.), 1-sun intensity. Current- voltage measurements were conducted periodically to identify premature degradation. Subtask 2.2 – Failure analysis: Systematic evaluation was not performed due to sample transaction and project timeline limiting the ability to conduct regular analyses. Task 3.0: Training and results dissemination Subtask 3.1 – Hiring student(s) from under-represented groups (URGs): UH recruited one undergraduate (UG) student from URGs. The students participated in daily research activities and teleconferences with the NREL team collaborating in the project.
